Eshooter Kestrel V3 Basic Mosfet

  • Brushless Motor
    Support brushless and high-speed/high-torque motors
  • Locked Rotor Protection
    When gear and motor work out of order prevents gearbox damage
  • Active Braking
    Adaptive function to avoid gear instability, ensure piston stops in front position, increase gearbox and inside parts’ service life
  • Support Different Batteries

products.name: Eshooter KESTREL V2 SE – Backwired Bluetooth MOSFET For Gel Blaster
products.short_description: Eshooter V2 SE Mosfet, a brand new designed electronic trigger unit for your replica. With Eshooter App control and reliable mechnical trigger switch, it can perfectly avoid complicated testing and know your AEG details through your phone. Try with affordable price, Kestrel V2 SE won’t let you regret.
products.description:
Eshooter V2 SE Mosfet is a budget-friendly Bluetooth MOSFET that delivers essential performance and smart control.

Key Features of the Eshooter Kestrel Bluetooth Mosfet/ ETU System

•Pre-Cocking Adjustment
Fine-tune pre-cocking mode with 100 levels of precision, ensuring optimal performance in all firing modes and improving trigger response.

•Brushless Motor Support
Fully compatible with high-speed, high-torque, and brushless motors for enhanced power and reliability.

•Selector Modes
Customize firing modes, including SAFE, SEMI, BINARY, Burst, AUTO, and Sniper, for a tailored shooting experience that suits your tactical needs. (AUG Mode is not available)

•Personalized Settings
Save up to 5 custom settings and rename your device for a truly personalized experience. Switch profiles effortlessly via the app.

•ROF Control (Rate of Fire)
Adjust the rate of fire to your preference, even when using high-voltage batteries, for consistent and controlled performance.

•Sensor Calibration
Built-in calibration ensures precise alignment with your gearbox for optimal performance and accuracy.

•Battery Protection
Prevents over-discharge of LiPo/LiFe batteries by monitoring voltage levels. The app provides low-battery warnings to ensure your equipment stays powered.

•Active Brake
Prevents double shots by ensuring the piston stops in the forward position, extending the life of internal components and improving reliability.

•Cycle Detection
Detects gear cycle completion with a rack sensor. Supports DSG, HSG, and standard gear configurations for versatility.

•Firmware Updates
Keep your system up to date with free OTA (Over-The-Air) updates via the Eshooter App.

•Smart Fuse Protection
Built-in intelligent fuse system protects the motor, battery, and controller from overheating, overloading, and short circuits.

•Sleep Mode
Automatically enters sleep mode after one hour of inactivity to conserve battery power. Simply reconnect the battery to reactivate. Perfect for long MILSIM games.

•Locked Rotor Protection
Safeguards your gearbox from damage when gears or motors encounter issues.

•Sniper Delay Mode
Adds realistic shot delays of 0.5s, 1s, 2s, or 3s for precision shooting and a more immersive experience.

SPECIFICATION:

Product Weight: 27.6g
Dimensions (L/W/H): 47.4 x 28.7 x 13.5(mm)
Current: 17mA
Voltage Range: 3.75 – 17V
Compatible: V2 Gearbox

NOTE: The Eshooter V2 SE Mosfet is backwired for rear battery setups.

To ensure proper installation and maintain warranty coverage, we strongly recommend having the MOSFET installed by our qualified technicians. Any damage resulting from unauthorized installation will void the warranty.

Manufacturer: DK
Model: DK-AUG
products.description:
Made from high density nylon, 3D Printed, for greater strength. Designed for the LeHui LH AUG Steyr, though this hopup will generally fit onto any metal 14mm CCW threaded outer barrel.

Although the hopup itself doesn’t have any threads in the end that pushes onto the outer barrel, the inner diameter of the hopup should push onto most 14mm CCW threaded outer barrels. The reason we suggest only using on metal outer barrels, is that pushing this onto nylon outer barrels, will most likely cause damage to the threads on the nylon barrel.

DK-AUG Adjustable Hop Up for LH AUG Steyr Gel Blaster Features

  • Hop ups increase shooting distance  and improve accuracy by applying back spin on the gel balls as they leave the barrel,
  • High quality DK Hop Up,
  • Fully Adjustable,
  • Perfect fit for the LH AUG Steyr.

DK-AUG Adjustable Hop Up for LH AUG Steyr Gel Blaster instructions:

  • Push onto the threaded end of the outer barrel with flap on top.
  • Rotate the hopup to make sure the tongue is at the top most point, then tighten the 2 grub screws on either side to secure it to the barrel.
  • To adjust the degree of “Hop” and increase lift, simply adjust the angle of the hopup tongue by tightening or loosening the grub screw that is at the front, top most point of the hopup.

What’s in the pack:

  • 1 x Adjustable Hop Up
  • 1 x Allen Key (Hex Wrench [U.S.] lol)
  • 2 x Hex head grub screws (1 for use to adjust the hopup, plus one spare)

products.name: AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up
products.short_description:
Type: 3D Printer Polymer Hop Up/ Flash Hider
Material: High Tensile Polymer
Colour: Black
products.description:
Introducing the AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up

The AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up is designed to elevate both the performance and appearance of your gel blaster. With its aggressive muzzle brake styling and cutting-edge features, this hop-up enhances accuracy, range, and control during gameplay.

Building on the proven Muzzletek technology, the Hellfire hop-up offers unparalleled inner barrel stabilisation and precise 180° hop-up adjustment. This tool-less adjustment feature allows you to fine-tune hop settings effortlessly by rotating the front housing, giving you control over shot trajectory with ease.

The Hellfire side ports effectively disperse gases and vapour, replicating the look and function of a real muzzle brake. Designed for universal fitment, it supports 14mm counter-clockwise threaded gel blaster rifle barrels and accommodates inner barrels up to 12mm longer than the outer barrel.

AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up Key Features:

  • Aggressive muzzle brake design for enhanced aesthetics and performance
  • Advanced 180° tool-less hop-up adjustment for precision shooting
  • Inner barrel stabilisation for improved accuracy and consistency
  • Compatible with 14mm CCW threaded gel blaster barrels
  • Polymer tough construction for durability in the heat of battle
  • Ideal for M4 and AK variants, extending range and accuracy
  • Transform your gel blaster’s performance with the AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up, the perfect blend of style and functionality.

(Please note the 12mm, any more than 12mm and the inner barrel will make contact with the inner tongue of the hop unit and will either break the inner or push it out of its seat, we would recommend 10mm or 11mm maximum OR don’t turn the hellfire all the way onto your outer barrel to ensure it doesn’t make contact.)

AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up Fitment Instructions:

  • Thread the Hellfire in a reverse direct until threaded all the way on(maximum of 12mm) making sure to be careful that the inner barrel doesn’t make contact with the rear of the internal tongue. If it does make contact, unwind the hop until it has clearance.
  • It more than likely will not have perfect rotation alignment to set the hop ramp at 12 o’clock
  • Rotate to set the alignment correctly then use the side grub screws to hold the Hellfire firmly in the correct position
  • To adjust the hop up, Turn the slotted end cap to lower the hop ramp, the cap rotates just 90 degrees offering 8 settings
  • If a permanent fixture we would recommend using a low strength Loctite to hold the side grub screws in place and if you wish a small amount on the main thread from hop to out barrel.

Designed, made and hand assembled in Australia!

Thread of main hop up: M14 CCW

Adjustment: Tool-less, rotate the front face for adjustment

Fitment: 1.5mm Allen key for the 2x side locating grub screws.

To replace the inner assembly of the adjustable tongue, remove the front adjuster cap, ensure to use substantial amount of heat to release the Loctite holding the stainless grub screw for the adjuster cap. If you don’t you may strip the 1.5mm Allen head grub screw. If you strip the stainless steel grub screw then there is a high chance of ruining the outer to get it out.

Colour: Black
Style: M-Lok
Country of Origin: China
products.description:
Introducing the 13.7 Inch BAD RigidRail M-LOK Metal Handguard – Black

Upgrade your Gel Blaster with the 13.7-inch BAD RigidRail M-LOK metal handguard, offering superior strength, lightweight design, and unmatched versatility. Engineered from aircraft-grade 6061-T6 aluminium, this Gel Blaster handguard ensures durability without adding unnecessary weight, making it ideal for tactical use and precision shooting.

Featuring multiple M-LOK slots at the 3, 6, 9, and partial 12 o’clock positions, along with four 45° quick disconnect sling mounting options, this handguard offers flexible accessory placement for lights, lasers, and other tactical attachments. The proprietary RIGIDRAIL™ design provides a perfect balance of rigidity and manoeuvrability.

The built-in anti-rotation QD sling sockets, strategically placed at the front and rear, ensure secure sling attachment for comfortable carry.

Easy to install and maintain, this handguard is a perfect upgrade for your gel blaster setup. Experience the exceptional performance of a B.A.D.-inspired design at a fraction of the cost with this non-genuine, high-quality item from China.

13.7 Inch BAD RigidRail M-LOK Metal Handguard features:

  • Weight: 2258g
  • Length: 13.7 Inches (34.9 cm)
  • Proprietary RIGIDRAIL™ design, engineered for an optimal balance of lightweight construction and strength/rigidity
  • Partial Picatinny top rail, compatible with the BAD556-LW Lightweight Upper Receiver
  • Constructed from aircraft-grade 6061-T6 aluminium for durability
  • Inner diameter: 33.4 mm
  • M-LOK slots located at the 3, 6, 9, and partial 12 o’clock positions
  • Additional single M-LOK slots at four 45° positions, ideal for forward mounting of lights, lasers, and accessories
  • Barrel nut diameter: 35 mm
  • Barrel nut made from 7075 aluminium, Type 3 Class 2 hard anodised with a clear (bronze) finish
  • No barrel nut shims required
  • Four anti-rotation QD sling sockets: two at the front and two at the rear, positioned at the 3 o’clock and 9 o’clock points
  • Tapped hole at the front end for optional bipod or sling attachment at the 6 o’clock position
  • Internal diameter: 34 mm
  • Rotation-limited QD sockets

13.7 Inch BAD RigidRail M-LOK Metal Handguard Pack Contains:

  • 1 x 13.7 Inch BAD RigidRail M-LOK Metal Handguard
  • 1 x Pack (5) Shims

Please note: This is a fully functional replica toy item and is intended for us on Gel Blasters and other such toys. It is not designed for, nor rated for, use with real firearms.

products.short_description:

Material: Metal CNC Aluminium Alloy
Colour: Black
Style: RIS III – M-Lok
Country of Origin: China
products.description:
Introducing the 12.5 Inch Daniel Defense RIS-III M-LOK Metal Gel Blaster Handguard: a handguard that brings versatility and proven design to your gel blaster setup. Modelled after the renowned RIS II rail system used by U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM) since 2006, THE RIS III  handguard offers a lightweight yet durable solution for your tactical Gel Blaster needs.

Crafted from high-quality aircraft-grade 6061-T6 aluminium, this handguard ensures a robust and secure fit with its 6-bolt bolt-up system, attaching seamlessly to your upper receiver. The free-floating barrel design enhances accuracy, while the uninterrupted upper rail platform and Mil-Spec 1913 Picatinny rail provide a solid foundation for your accessories.

What sets this handguard apart is its M-LOK attachment system, featuring seven faces along the length of the handguard, for M-Lok accessory attachment. This allows for enhanced customization and flexibility, ensuring you can mount your accessories exactly where you need them. Additionally, integral QD swivel attachment points on both sides add to its versatility.

12.5 Inch Daniel Defense RIS-III M-LOK Metal Gel Blaster Handguard features:

  • Free-Floating Barrel Design for improved accuracy
  • Seven M-LOK Attachment Positions for enhanced customization
  • Aircraft Grade 6061-T6 Aluminium Construction for durability
  • Proven 6-Bolt Bolt-Up System for secure attachment
  • Uninterrupted Upper Rail Platform with Mil-Spec 1913 Picatinny Rail
  • Compatible with RIS II bolt-up system, using the same barrel nut and bolt-up plate

Upgrade your gel blaster with the 12.5 Inch Daniel Defense RIS-III M-LOK Metal Gel Blaster Handguard for a robust, versatile, and extremely authentic-looking addition to your gear.

  • Inside Diameter: 3.8 cm
  • Barrel Nut Steel

  • Integrated Sling Swivel Attachment Point Yes

products.name: CowCow TM Hi-Capa Custom Grip – Black
products.short_description:
PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS

Material: Polymer
Compatibility: It is compatible with WE-Tech, Tokyo Marui and other compatible Hi-CAPA 5.1 Series Gel Blaster GBB Pistols
products.description:
CCT TM Hi-Capa Custom Grip was constructed by Polymer. Its slim and streamlined body design allows a better feeling on gripping. The modified trigger guard offers an indexing point to assist in consistent gripping of the pistol. The enhanced trigger ring rail helps to give the trigger a more direct and sensitive trigger pull. This grip is ready out of the box for grip tape or stippling without any further modifications needed. It is compatible with WE-Tech, Tokyo Marui and other compatible Hi-CAPA 5.1 Series gel blaster GBB Pistols.

**Important Notice**

It may has a condition that your pistol cannot feed the gel ammo due to lightweight gas supply. You just simple remove a spacer to solve the issue. Alternatively, you may consult your pistol tech for advancing fitting to solve this issue as well.

Increasing in FPS can be achieved; however, it may require other parts to collaborate and advanced skill is needed. improper installation / fitting can shorten the life of the product.

*PS: Please note: installing parts / assemble /fitting airsoft gun will need intermediate knowledge; for expert or gel ball gunsmith. Please refer to your gel ball gunsmith for proper installation / fitting. Fitting may be needed as the condition of each gel ball gun might be different. Regular maintenance is needed for all gel ball guns in order to keep it in good working condition and reduce wear out issue on parts. The actual performance is based on the overall setting on your airsoft gun. Please consult your gel ball gunsmith for advising. Strong Screw glue is needed for installation. Use a drop of screw glue when installing the screw and wait for it to dry out overnight. Damage could be caused to the screw thread if screw glue was not used.

This X-Force Black Label lithium charging bag is intended to reduce the chance of damage in the event of a LiPo fire
Not recommended for batteries exceeding 30 watt-hours

1. Ensure that charger rate is properly set and polarity is correct
2. Attach charging leads to battery
3. Place battery toward the bottom of the LiPo Safe Bag
4. Place the LiPo Safe Bag on a non-flammable surface
5. Route charge leads through either vent at the sides of the flap top seam of the LiPo Safe Bag
6. Close top flap of the LiPo Safe Bag and press hook and loop closure fully closed
7. Charge battery using proper charging practices

products.description:
X-Force Bulk-Pack Orange Gel Balls

Stock up and skirmish longer with X-Force Bulk-Pack Orange Gel Balls — consistent, high-absorbency gel ammo designed for all-round performance and reliable feeding in AEG, spring and gas gel blaster platforms. Manufactured from superabsorbent polymer (primarily sodium polyacrylate), each bead hydrates to a uniform spherical shape with a predictable flight profile and excellent feed reliability. The bright orange colour improves visibility for gauging thier flight when fired while still offering good impact performance for CQB and outdoor play.

Perfect for field operators, events and retail bundles, these bulk packs are offered in 500g pack, giving you plenty of gels in one batch. The beads hydrate quickly (approximately 4hrs) and maintain roundness and tensile strenght during use — ideal for players who want dependable, fuss-free ammo that’s simple to store and prepare. Supplied in an air-tight, resealable pouch, you can choose between growing small batches, or throw the lot in, if you’ve got a long event or filed hire to consider.

X-Force Bulk-Pack Orange Gel Balls Features:

  • Premium bulk-pack gel ammo — great value for teams, clubs, indoor and outdoor field operators and retailers.
  • Bright orange beads for easy visibility durting play.
  • Made from superabsorbent polymer (primarily sodium polyacrylate) — high water retention.
  • Consistent sphericity and size for reliable magazine feeding and accuracy.
  • Quick hydration: absorb water to recommended size with simple soak procedure, for roughly 4 hours, or until you have achieved the desired size, for size specific controlled grow.
  • Suitable for AEG, spring and gas gel blasters.
  • Resealable 500g Pouch, for bulk buy cost benefits.
  • Store dry in cool conditions — long shelf life when unhydrated.
  • X-Force Orange Gels are a harden gel used with most gel blasters that run the 7-8 mm gels.

X-Force Bulk-Pack Orange Gel Balls specs:

  • Brand / Manufacturer: X-Force (X-Force Tactical)
  • Product: Bulk-Pack Orange Gel Balls (GelSoft Ammo)
  • Material: Superabsorbent polymer (SAP) — primarily sodium polyacrylate (cross-linked polymer)
  • Hydrated bead diameter (typical): ~7–8 mm (can vary slightly by soak time and water temp)
  • Dry form: compressed bead / crystal (hydrates into soft sphere)
  • Pack sizes: 500g
  • Recommended soak: Approx. 4 hours (shorter times can be used for controlled grows)
  • Recommended use: CQB, outdoor skirmish, target practice, events, field operatots and retail resale
  • Storage (unhydrated): cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture, in the resealable zip lock pouch
  • Storage (hydrated): Store in large, airtight containers, such as soda bottle or large milk containers.
  • Safety: non-toxic when used as directed; keep out of reach of children & pets; avoid ingestion and eye contact. Always wear eye protection when firing Gels

 

 

Do Not Freeze and/or add washing liquid or any other lubricant to the water as this can damage your gel blaster.

  • Storage (unhydrated): cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture, in the resealable zip lock pouch
  • Storage (hydrated): Store in large, airtight containers, such as soda bottle or large milk containers.
  • Safety: non-toxic when used as directed; keep out of reach of children & pets; avoid ingestion and eye contact. Always wear eye protection when firing Gels

 

 

Do Not Freeze and/or add washing liquid or any other lubricant to the water as this can damage your gel blaster.

products.description:
WE-Tech Hi-Capa 6″ T-REX “FORCE” Competition Gas Blowback Gel Blaster Pistol – Black/Silver/Markings        

WE-Techs new line of Hi-Capa Gel Blaster pistols, the T-REX line brings new innovations to WE-Techs line of Hi-Capa Pistols.

The T-REX line features a more ergonomic, redesigned grip with simulated stippling, improving the shooters grip. The IREX line utilizes CNC finishing to ensure reliable fitment and improved performance.

The T-REX line also utilizes a stronger recoil spring and short stroke buffer to give the gel blaster a more realistic recoil and improved cyclic rate. With a variety of designs and barrel lengths, the T-REX line has a pistol that will appeal to any Gelsoft fan.

WE TECH gas blowback gel blaster pistols represent some of the best value and best bang for buck pistols proven worldwide as high performers and reliability above their price tag, these Gelsoft versions are no different!

FEATURES 

  • M12 CCW THREAD OUTER BARREL
  • CNC finished slide and frame
  • Slide cuts lighten slide and give the blaster a competition style look
  • Front and rear fibre optic sights with adjustable rear sight
  • Competition style barrel, Railed frame for lights or accessories, Bevelled magwell assists in reloads
  • Anti-glare grooving along the spine of the pistol reduces glare
  • Functioning beavertail safety
  • Brushed stainless accents
  • Included micro-dot mount

SPECS

Always use the appropriate eye wear and take all reasonable safety precautions when using our products.

 

Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in warm water from the tap for a minimum of 4-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain off any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

 

DISCLAIMER

Do not upgrade any part of your toy gel blaster as this will void the warranty. Upgrades refer to pulling any of the blaster apart or opening it up, changing springs or upgrading the battery from 7.4v to an 11.v battery.

products.description:
Description 

WE TECH G-Series Gen 4 G34 GBB Pistol Gel Blaster (Black) is Here!

The G-Series 34 gel blaster is a competition version of G-Series 17 which fires the same round as G-Series 17 and was introduced in 1998 in order to meet the maximum size requirement for many sanctioned action gelsoft pistol sporting events.

It features a longer barrel and slide (0.8 inch more) of G-Series 17 and the top of the slide and parts of its inside are milled out, creating a conspicuous hole at the top designed to reduce front-end muzzle weight to better balance the pistol and reduce the overall weight of the slide.

Although the G-Series 34 is mainly for sport shooting, some law enforcement uses the G-Series 34 as their sidearm based on its high accuracy.

The WE TECH G-Series 34 gel blaster features a Metal Slide with a “G-Series v34 Tactical” marking, a discrete ejector and outer barrel, a fixed front sight with white dots on the outer barrel, and tactical rear sight with white dots.

It also features a Polymer Gen 4 Lower Frame with “Gen 4” marking, an extended slide stop, and 2 pcs of changeable grip with extended pin and Realistic trigger function, the same as real steel.

Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in warm water from the tap for a minimum of 4-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain off any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

 

DISCLAIMER

Do not upgrade any part of your toy gel blaster as this will void the warranty. Upgrades refer to pulling any of the blaster apart or opening it up, changing springs or upgrading the battery from 7.4v to an 11.v battery.

products.description:
Umarex Smoke Wagon Colt SAA Peacemaker V2 .45 Limited Edition Revolver – by Wingun

Step into the Wild West with the Wingun Colt SAA Peacemaker .45 Revolver Gel Blaster — a fully functioning, single-action revolver styled after the legendary Colt Single Action Army, but built for gel-ball blasting fun. With a full-metal body, smooth cylinder cycling and CO₂ power-system built into the grip, this model delivers authentic feel and performance. With a vintage “Smoke Wagon” nickel and gold finish and six-shot shell system, it’s as much a display piece as it is a thrill to shoot. Ideal for gel-ball skirmish, backyard fun or collector display, this revolver offers 300+ FPS performance and solid build quality that appeals to serious players and enthusiasts alike.

Whether you’re blasting gel balls in your CQB field or showing off the iconic Peacemaker silhouette on your wall, this Wingun model ticks both boxes. Just load in one of the six brass shells, attach a 12 g CO₂ cartridge (sold separately), load your 7-8 mm gel balls and you’re good to go.

Umarex Smoke Wagon Colt SAA Peacemaker V2 .45 Limited Edition Revolver Features:

  • Full-metal body for realism and durability.
  • Version 2 design with upgraded internals and gas efficiency (Compared with Version 1)
  • Realistic single-action revolver mechanism — manual cocking of hammer, cylinder rotation included.
  • CO₂ powered (12 g non-threaded cartridge required) — no battery needed.
  • Six-shell gel-ball cartridge system — each shell holds one 7-8 mm gel balls for true revolver feel.
  • High performance: rated at 300+ FPS (subject to gel quality, CO₂ strength & local conditions).
  • Iconic design: based on the Colt Single Action Army “Peacemaker” revolver — Western styling meets modern gel-ball fun.
  • Collector and skirmish ready — the finish and mechanics suit display and field use alike.
  • Other uses: Ideal for Cosplay or Western reenactment shows.
  • Maintenance friendly: shell re-loading, easy CO₂ replacement.

Umarex Smoke Wagon Colt SAA Peacemaker V2 .45 Limited Edition Revolver Specs:

  • Brand / Manufacturer: Wingun (under Umarex / licensing)
  • Model: Colt SAA Peacemaker .45 Revolver Gel Blaster
  • Finish / Colour: Nickel and Gold “Smoke Wagon” design.
  • Material: Full metal body (metal frame & cylinder)
  • Operation: CO₂ powered single-action revolver
  • Cartridge System: Six brass shells included
  • Ammunition: 7-8 mm gel balls (gel-ball ammo)
  • FPS (approx): 300+ FPS (verified by retailer)
  • Power Source: 12g non-threaded CO₂ cartridge (not included)
  • Recommended Use: Gel-ball skirmish, backyard practice, display collector piece
  • Included in Box: 1 x revolver unit, 6 x brass shells
  • Not Included: CO₂ cartridge, gel-ball ammo, maintenance oil/grease (maintenance recommended)

Please note: The gap between the hammer and the body of the revolver is completely normal, and is not a defect. The hammer is held slightly away from tyhe body of the revolver, by the gas release valve’s spring pressure. If you push the hammer, so that it is flush with the back of the revolver body, then gas will escape through the valve.

products.description:
The Thompson submachine gun is an American submachine gun first invented by John T. Thompson in 1918 during World War I and became infamous during the Prohibition era, being a signature weapon of various organized crime syndicates in the United States. It was a common sight in the media of the time, being used by both law enforcement officers and criminals.  The Thompson submachine gun was also known informally as the “Tommy Gun”, “Street Sweeper”, “Annihilator”, “Chicago Typewriter”, “Trench Broom”, “Chicago Submachine”, “Chicago Piano”, “Chicago Style”, “Chicago Organ Grinder”, “Drum Gun”, “the Chopper”, “the Tommy Boy” or simply “the Thompson”.

The Thompson was favored by soldiers, criminals, police, the FBI, and civilians alike for its fully automatic fire, while still being relatively lightweight, portable and easy to use. It has since gained popularity among civilian collectors for its historical significance. It has considerable significance in popular culture, especially in works about the Prohibition era and World War II, and is one of the most well known and recognized firearms in history. The original fully automatic Thompsons are no longer produced, but numerous semi-automatic civilian versions are still being manufactured by Auto-Ordnance. These retain a similar appearance to the original models, but they have various modifications in order to comply with modern firearm laws.

This Thompson gel blaster is truly a first for the gel blaster industry.

It comes with:

  • proprietary Thompson gearbox
  • Stick mag

Construction is of nylon with some metal parts.

Gel blasters are toys only and are NOT weapons or firearms.

Always use the appropriate eye wear and take all reasonable safety precautions when using our products.

NOTE: Please note, gels included with blasters are generally of low quality and can often cause feeding issues, we highly recommend you purchase our high quality harden gels for the best performance.( X-Force Black Label gels)

DESCRIPTION

Type: Gel blaster

Material: Nylon/Metal

Uses: 7-8 mm gels

The M1 and M1A1 had a barrel without cooling fins, a simplified rear sight, provisions only for box magazines, employed a straight blowback action and the charging handle was on the side of the receiver.

Over 1.5 million military Thompson submachine guns were produced during World War 2.

products.description:
Custom made CNC anti rotation bushes by Aztech Innovations. 

Manufactured from 440 grade stainless steel with rock well hardness of 60HRC

Machined to 8mm (8.02mm ) to within 0.001mm tolerances. These are made .02 of a mm oversize to ensure a snug fit with out warping the gearbox from over tension. 

We recommend a light press or bearing tool for installation. Do not Impact with a hammer or blunt force tooling to ensure no damage is caused to the gearbox.  We highly recommend using a JB Weld Original epoxy as an adhesive to bond the bushes into place to ensure they can not move or come loose in the gearbox.

Suits next generation gearboxes that accept “The Aztech Bushing” V2 and V3 style gearbox’s – gel ball and airsoft compatible.  May be too shallow for some nylon gearboxes to be securely retained.
These do not suit Singularity 13 Gen 8 Gearboxes.

Includes 6x Bushes

Stainless bushes must be lubricated with a high quality bearing and gear grease.  We highly recommend Nulon Xtreme Performance Grease with PTFE (L80) which is a blend of Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) fluorocarbon particles in a specially prepared lithium-based, water-repellent grease. 

PTFE L80 keeps water and dust out while a plating of PTFE is applied to the mating surfaces under working conditions. Seal performance is improved and operating temperature reduced, resulting in less grease “throw”. L80 is the perfect grease for our CNC bushes and gears.

L80 has a continuous temperature operating range of -9°C to 150°C

  • Finger, Gels and Flashing LEDs, where each press of the trigger flexes the fingers, lights up the infinity stones and shoots a Gel Ball from between the middle fingers. (Power switch in the “On” position)

This Marvel Sci-Fi inspired Gel Blaster will be hours of fun for the young ones. Having running battles in the street with mates from your neighbourhood.

Although rated for ages 14+, it would be suitable for slightly younger users, provided they are under constant adult supervision. Regardless of age though, eye protection must always be used, when playing with Gel Blasters.

  • Cool finger movement when the trigger button is pressed
  • The ability to shoot, non toxic, biodegradable Gel Ball from between the middle fingers.

products.description:
SPECTRE M4 PDW SMG Gel Blaster — Compact PDW-Style Gel-Ball SMG (Sub Machine Gun)

The SPECTRE M4 PDW SMG Gel Blaster brings compact, PDW-style firepower to your kit with an aggressive modern profile and user-focused ergonomics. Built for CQB and close-quarters gameplay, this gel-blaster replica typically features a short barrel, integrated foregrip area (battery Compartment) and a smooth feeding double stack style magazine system. Lightweight yet robust, the SPECTRE M4 is ideal as a primary SMG for tight CQB play or as a fast, manoeuvrable secondary for urban scenarios.

Designed for players who prioritise handling and speed, the SPECTRE M4 offers responsive trigger feel, reliable feeding and easy battery/magazine access — making it a popular choice for club nights and backyard skirmishes alike. With upgrade potential for hop-up, inner barrel and gearbox components, it’s a versatile base for performance tuning or cosmetic customisation to match your style on the field.

Brief Real-World History

The real Spectre M4 is an Italian submachine gun designed in the 1980s by Roberto Teppa and Claudio Gritti and produced by SITES (later by Greco Sport). It is a compact, high-rate-of-fire SMG known for its distinctive casket (four-column) magazines and top-folding stock. Production in Italy ran through the 1980s and 1990s, with small runs continuing into the early 2000s; the weapon was used in several regional conflicts and sold in both military and civilian (semi-automatic) variants.

  • Compact PDW/SMG silhouette ideal for CQB and close-quarters play
  • Reliable feeding system — hopper or mid-cap compatible (variant dependant)
  • Folding or telescopic stock for fast manoeuvrability and storage
  • Robust polymer and metal external options depending on model
  • User-serviceable internals with upgrade paths for hop-up, inner barrel and gearbox
  • Quick access battery compartment and tool-free maintenance points
  • Lightweight handling for fast target acquisition and quick transitions
  • Suitable for beginners and seasoned players seeking a compact primary or agile secondary

SPECTRE M4 PDW SMG Gel Blaster Performance:

The SPECTRE M4 is built for players who demand realism, performance, and reliability. Whether you’re a serious gel blaster enthusiast, a collector, or just love the legendary MP5K design, this model is a must-have.

products.description:
SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – V4 Rifle

🔥 The SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – V4 is a modern, feature-rich CQB platform designed for players who want something visually distinctive without sacrificing performance or durability. Built around a striking translucent receiver set, the T4 V4 allows you to see the internals at work while delivering solid out-of-the-box functionality that feels far more premium than its price point suggests.

One of the standout features is the MagPrime system, allowing you to prime the magazine directly via the charging handle — a simple but hugely appreciated upgrade that improves feeding reliability and speeds up reloads during fast-paced CQB play. Internally, the T4 is equipped with a metal inner barrel for improved accuracy and consistency, while the textured outer barrel and metal components throughout give it a reassuringly solid feel in the hands.

This V4 (Version4)  variant is almost fully ambidextrous, featuring a functional ambidextrous bolt release and ambidextrous fire selector, making it equally comfortable for left- or right-handed players. The only ambidextrous thing that could be added would be an ambidextrous magazine release, which is right-hand only. The included metal Picatinny iron sights mount securely and provide a rugged backup aiming solution, while the metal thumb-stop style foregrip enhances weapon control during aggressive cornering and close-quarters engagements.

SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – Inclusive extras.

A particularly clever design detail is the included suppressor, which offers ample internal clearance beyond the inner barrel, making it ideal for adding and concealing a hop-up unit in the future without altering the external appearance. Combined with M-LOK mounting points, two included metal 5-slot Picatinny plates, and quick-release sling mounting holes, the SLR-T4 is a highly adaptable platform that’s ready to be customised to suit your playstyle.

Whether you’re building a lightweight CQB setup or a visually unique showpiece that still performs on the field, the SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – V4 is a seriously compelling option.

Key Features of the SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – V4:

  • Translucent M4A1-style CQB gel blaster design
  • MagPrime system – prime the magazine using the charging handle
  • Metal inner barrel for improved accuracy and consistency

products.description:
SKD Mini G19 Manual Gel Blaster

The SKD Mini G19 Manual Gel Blaster is an extremely compact, fun-sized blaster designed for players of all ages and backyard mucking around. At approximately half-life-size, this small-format gel blaster offers easy handling, lightweight construction and simple operation, making it ideal for beginners or casual backyard fun. Its reduced size means smaller hands can grip it comfortably, while still delivering the satisfying feel of a classic G-Series style design.

Unlike most manual gel blaster pistols that require you to rack the slide before each shot, the SKD Mini G19 operates directly from the trigger mechanism. Simply load your gels, pull the trigger and fire. This streamlined system makes it quicker and easier to use, especially for younger players who may struggle with stiff slide actions on traditional springer pistols.

The hopper-fed design adds another layer of convenience. Gels are loaded through a sliding opening on the top of the blaster, eliminating the need for a removable magazine. This keeps the design simple, reduces moving parts and makes reloads fast and straightforward. For safe, lightweight backyard plinking and entry-level gel ball fun, the SKD Mini G19 is an excellent choice.

SKD Mini G19 Manual Gel Blaster Features:

  • Compact half-size design – ideal for younger players (Can only be sold to persons over 18 years of age, but can be used by persons 14+ years, under direct adult supervision)
  • Manual trigger-operated firing system – no slide racking required
  • Hopper-fed system for simple loading
  • Sliding top hatch for quick gel refills
  • Lightweight and easy to handle
  • Low-powered manual operation for backyard target shooting
  • G-Series inspired styling (Labelled as a G19, though it has a mock selector switch, like a G18 has)

Technical Specifications:

  • Model: SKD Mini G19
  • Operation: Manual (trigger-activated spring system)
  • Feed System: Internal hopper (top loading)
  • Loading Method: Sliding top opening
  • Approximate Size: Half life-size format
  • Recommended Gel Size: 7–8mm hydrated gel balls
  • Use Case: Backyard target practice / entry-level play

The SKD Mini G19 Manual Gel Blaster delivers simple, safe and lightweight gel ball fun in a compact package that’s easy for anyone to pick up and enjoy.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” even when using a tiny Gel blaster like this one, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

This Classic Army Gel Blaster version of the MP5SD is a beautiful rendition in 1 to 1 scale of a model specifically developed to meet the requirements of many Special Operations Forces around the world!

The MP5 is a submachine gun, developed by a German manufacturer in the 1960s. A typical MP5 fires 9mm Luger ammunition from a curved detachable box-type magazine. The MP5’s accuracy, reliability, and wide range of accessories and variants have made it the submachine gun (SMG) of choice for military and law enforcement agencies worldwide.

The Classic Army MP5SD has a metal suppressor, cocking tube and receiver. The short barrel provides good accuracy up to medium to long range.
This model is fantastic out of the box and includes a metal magazine to get the job done, swiftly, efficiently and without fault.

FEATURES

Charging Batteries

Do not leave batteries unattended whilst charging and take off charge when they have completed charging.

When charging the batteries, we recommend charging them between 1-4 hours.
When they are charging the light/s will flash and once it is fully charged, the light/s will turn a solid red or green.

Also once you start to hear the battery getting flat, please recharge it as running it flat can damage the cells.

 Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain of any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

You can store gel balls in a bucket of water with a lid for up to 3 months before they start to go super soft. We recommend if you do this to change the water every couple of weeks.

DISCLAIMER
Do not upgrade any part of your toy gel blaster as this will void the warranty. Upgrades refer to pulling any of the blaster apart or opening it up, changing springs or upgrading the battery from 7.4v to an 11.v battery.

Whether you’re running an M4 platform, an SMG build, or a tactical pistol setup, this optic adds both performance and aggressive modern styling to your loadout.

Run it in a streamlined profile for speed and reduced weight, or install the protective shroud for added durability during hard skirmish play. Windage and elevation adjustments give you precise zeroing control, while the compact footprint keeps your blaster balanced and manoeuvrable. products.description:
Specifications

Introducing the Scylla by Jefftron – V2 optical Mosfet Electronic Trigger Unit

A cutting-edge performance upgrade for your Gel Blaster or AEG, designed to enhance trigger responsiveness, firing modes, and overall reliability. This state-of-the-art unit is packed with advanced features and provides seamless control through the Leviathan & Scylla app.

The Scylla – V2 optical is one of the most advanced ETU (electronic trigger unit) on the market

It combines optical and magnetic sensors for better handling and durability

Built-in wireless communication for quick setup using iOS or Android smartphones!

An adapter with magnet, is attached on the trigger, so you can adjust its sensitivity conveniently from the app

The Scylla offers everything you would expect from a processor unit:

  • Binary trigger
  • Burst fire
  • Trigger sensitivity
  • Rate of fire reduction
  • Piston pre-cocking
  • Li-Po alarm
  • statistics and much more

Real time response for any change in the settings – immediately feel the results

Easy to instal into the gearbox (fully integrated inside the gearbox instead of the original trigger contacts)

New functions are for free for every user via online update

The Scylla – V2 provides everything that’s important for your blaster!

Scylla by Jefftron – V2 optical Mosfet Electronic Trigger Unit Key Features:

  • Adjustable Trigger Sensitivity: Fine-tune trigger response using the magnet adapter, which can be easily used on standard V2 triggers or Jefftron-specific triggers.
  • Customizable Fire Modes: Configure and assign fire modes to your firing switch, including:
    • SAFE: No response to trigger pulls.
    • Semi: Single shot per trigger pull.
    • Binary Trigger: One shot on pull, another on release.
    • Burst: Fires a burst with each pull.
    • Burst/Full-Auto: Short press for burst, long press for full-auto.
    • Full-Auto: Continuous fire until trigger release.
  • Rate of Fire Reduction: Adjust your RoF between 40%-100% via the app, ideal for optimizing performance or diagnosing issues.
  • Active Brake System: Solve double-burst issues with weak springs by braking the motor after each shot, fully adjustable in the app from 0-100%.
  • Piston Pre-cocking: Enhance trigger response by pre-cocking the piston in semi mode, adjustable up to 80% for ultra-quick shots.
  • Electronic Fuse Protection: Built-in protection against short circuits ensures the safety of your device.
  • Li-Po Battery Alarm: Automatically detects and alerts you when battery voltage is low, preserving the longevity of your gear.
  • Advanced Stats: Access real-time data such as RoF, shot count, cycle time, motor temperature, and battery voltage to optimize performance.
  • Compatible with Brushless Motors: Easily integrate with brushless motors such as Warhead, with full app support.

Built to Last:

The Scylla V2 is protected against water damage with a durable lacquer coating. Installation is a breeze, with support for a mechanical trigger stop (optional).

Included in the Package:

  • Scylla V2 electronic module with wiring to stock and T-plug connector
  • Magnet adapter for standard trigger
  • Securing screw, wire holders, and stickers
  • Dog Tag keychain
  • Online manual for easy setup

The Scylla by Jefftron takes your gameplay to the next level, offering precise control and unmatched reliability in the heat of battle. Perfect for Gel Blaster enthusiasts and Airsoft players looking to elevate their tactical experience.

Features

  • Machined aluminum alloy frame and slide provides rugged reliability without sacrificing weight
  • Officially licensed Salient Arms International trademarks
  • Front and rear combat style sights with integrated forward fiber optic
  • Machined anti-glare slide top, 2011 SAI Grip panels, ambidextrous safety and squared trigger
  • Titanium nitride style SAI barrel and on-frame integrated accessory rail
  • Powered by both Green gas magazine by AW Custom
  • Deep engraving w/ realistic external finish, look, and feel
  • Full auto select fire w/ superior performance, 1:1 scale, and realistic blowback

There are a plethora of 2011 style competition pistols on the market. Many of them are fine competition guns, but they lack the rugged durability and dependability of a solid, reliable duty or personal defense weapon. Seeing this gap in the market, and already well known for making high performance, rugged weapon systems, Salient Arms set to work producing a double stack 1911 that could clean up at the competition range and defend your home or protect your life in the field. The end result of years of research was the Salient Arms DS 2011 pistol. Precision machined with a form follows function attitude the SAI DS was manufactured for no other purpose in mind then to fill the needs of the hardcore shooting enthusiast. Equipped with aggressive front and rear slide serrations, milled lightening cuts on both side of the slide and aggressive competition style sights the SAI DS clearly is a pistol designed for shooters by shooters. As with all of their products, Salient Arms rewrote the rules of 2011 style pistols when they manufactured the DS, forging a new trail and leaving old conventions behind, the end result is a pistol that functions in the harshest conditions, under the heaviest of stresses and provides service you can stake your life on.

EMG has extended their collaboration with the Salient Arms and is proud to release the Salient Arms x EMG DS 2011 collaboration Training pistol gel blaster. Manufactured with an eye to detail the EMG SAI DS 2011 is CNC machined from aluminum alloy and features all of the trademarks of a Salient Arms pistol, incuding: a titanium nitride style barrel, competition style sights with fiber optic front insert, ambidextrous safety and, of course, stamped Salient Arms International rollmarks. Utilizing the Tokyo Marui Hi-Capa gas system, the Salient Arms / EMG DS pistol can be upgraded from a wide pool of available parts and components, ensuring easy repair and maintenance and years of reliable service.

Dimensions: 205mm x 150mm
Gas Type: Green Gas
Firing Mode: Semi/Full Automatic, Safety
System: Gas Blowback
Package Includes: Gun, Magazine
Manufacturer: EMG / Licensed by Salient Arms International.

FEATURES

  • Frame integrated 20mm accessory rail is ideal for mounting weapon lights and other accessories
  • Fiber optic front sight and SAI rear sight, designed specifically for single handed manipulation (compatible with all TM spec sights)

  • Precision CNC machined, weather-resistant black anodized finish aluminum alloy slide with licensed deep engraved SAI logos and trademarks

Designed, manufactured and marketed, entirely in house by Salient Arms, the SAI BLU is the first production handgun from SAI. Using feedback from real world users, Salient Arms developed the SAI BLU to fill the void between M&P ergonomics and Glock reliability. With aggressive cocking serrations, ergonomically designed grip and trigger guard and interchangeable backstraps the SAI BLU is designed to perform under the most rigorous and austere of conditions, no matter what the shooter requires of it.

The Salient Arms International Tier One line of lides from EMG are a great way to give your SAI BLU a unique and aggressive look! Not only do they look cool, they also preserve the performance of your EMG SAI BLU. Each slide is CNC machined from aluminum, preserving that crisp, snappy blowback action from the original BLU slide. All slides feature deep-engraved SAI trademarks. The gold barrel features deep-engraved SAI trademarks, along with internal threading for use with compatible threaded adapters. Gold barrels are coated in a TiN color finish, giving them an authentic, realistic look.

products.description:
Rampage Extra High-Capacity Magazine for AR15-HK416 Gel Blasters

High-Capacity. Aggressive. Built to Dominate.

The Rampage Extra High-Capacity AR15 / HK416 Gel Blaster Magazine is designed for players who refuse to reload mid-engagement. Featuring a double-width, extended-capacity design, this magazine delivers sustained firepower for CQB, skirmish, and competitive gel blaster gameplay.

Engineered to suit pretty much every brand and variant of M4 / AR15 / HK416-style gel blasters, the Rampage magazine includes two interchangeable top plates, allowing it to be tuned for compatibility across virtually every major AR-platform gel blaster brand we’ve tested. This makes it one of the most versatile high-capacity magazines available in Australia.

Rampage Extra High-Capacity Magazine Features:

  • Extra High-Capacity Design: Double-width internal layout holds significantly more gels than standard AR magazines, reducing reloads during gameplay.
  • Dual Interchangeable Top Plates Included: Supplied with two swappable feed plates to maximise compatibility across different AR15 / M4 / HK416 gel blaster brands.
  • Broad Platform Compatibility: Tested with a wide range of M4-style and HK416 gel blasters commonly sold in Australia.
  • Aggressive Tactical Styling: Modern, angular body design complements contemporary AR builds and QRF-style loadouts.
  • Durable Polymer Construction: Built to withstand repeated reloads, mag changes, and field use.
  • Secure Lock-In Fit: Designed for stable seating in AR-style mag wells with minimal wobble.
  • Play Longer / Play Harder: Designed to reduce the need for frequent reloads, giving you more time in the thick of the action.

Rampage Extra High-Capacity Magazine Specs:

  • Type: High-Capacity Gel Blaster Mag
  • Compatibility: every major AR-platform gel blaster brand we’ve tested.
  • Material: Reinforced polymer/composite
  • Finish: Black
  • Weight (empty): 178 g
  • Fitment: Specifically for TG’s G36C Gel Blaster
  • Unique Feature: Specifically designed to be an Extra High-Capacity Magazine, compatible with every M4/AR15 style Blaster we have tried it in, from any brand of Blaster manufacturer,.

Why Choose The Rampage Extra Hich-Capacity Magazine for AR15-HK416 Gel Blasters

If you’re running an AR-platform gel blaster and want maximum uptime, fewer reloads, and broad cross-brand compatibility, the Rampage magazine is built for exactly that role. It’s ideal for CQB, competitive play, and high-tempo skirmishes, where reloads cost time and momentum.

Rampage Extra Hich-Capacity Magazine for AR15-HK416 Gel Blasters Included in the box:

  • 1 × Rampage Extra High-Capacity Double-Width Gel Blaster Magazine
  • 2 × Interchangeable Top Plates (pre-installed + thicker profile plate, for greater brand compatability)

products.description:
Quantum Mechanics ™ Lockable Magazine Pouch

With the success of Quick Holster launched in early 2017, Quantum Mechanics further develop its holster and made a tactical magazine pouch that comes with the following features:

Spring controlled magazine release plate

This pouch comes with a magazine release plate controlled by a tension spring. The plate acts as a lock to secure the magazine from being dropped by movement like jumping and running. A magazine release design used in a magazine pouch is barely found in the market. To draw the magazine out, user can simply touch down the plate by his index finger or middle finger to release the lock. The smooth low friction interior surface allows for a fast magazine removal and easy one-handed insertion of the magazine.

Heavy duty injection moulded polymer construction

The pouch is made by polymer in military grade. It will provide you with a lifetime of performance. The polymer holds up in extreme heat and doesn’t become fragile in low temperatures.  It will not bend or stretch over time and is impervious to sweat and solvents

Curve Shape Belt loop and MOLLE compatible.

This pouch comes with a curve shape belt loop. It is designed to be worn outside the waistband hooked to a belt in a very comfortable, very easy to access method of carrying additional magazines. It standard comes with adjustable belt loop system accommodates belts of various sizes. The belt clip is designed for MOLLE use so you can mount this pouch on any MOLLE gears too.

Suits XTP, Shark, Hornet and Dragonfly mags.  Does not suit STI 2011

products.description:
With the PolarStar UGS (Universal Gas Stock) you can now get the performance advantage of a HPA system without needing to be tethered to a remote air rig and still retain the likeness and function of a traditional adjustable AR-15 stock. It can be used with any of the PolarStar cylinder conversion kits such as the F2™, F1™, JACK™ or Kythera™ and is compact enough that it can also be used with other similar HPA cylinder systems on the market.

Its integral regulator shares the same internal design as PolarStar’s other compact regulators and delivers performance on par with systems twice its size. This regulator has an output pressure range of 40-130psi which is easily adjusted using a 3/32 allen key but can be locked out using a standard chrono zip tie which blocks the adjustment screw. Additionally, if you want to get a little more “omph” out of the regulator, you can install the High Pressure Spring which boots the maximum output pressure to approximately 200psi.

The CO2 configuration comes with a different rail that allows it to accept our 12g or 33g CO2 Inserts which makes it possible to use traditional Milspec buttstocks. Your choice of a 12g or 33g CO2 insert is included with the CO2 models. The 33g CO2 models accept threaded CO2 cartridges while the 12g CO2 models use the standard 12g cartridges commonly used for Gelsoft and Air Guns. One can configure the same UGS for the use of either the 2.000″ HPA tanks or Milspec CO2 inserts by purchasing the different UGS Stock Rails separately. 


The HPA configuration includes G&P R3 buttstock pictured.

The CO2 configuration includes your choice of 12g or 33g CO2 inserts.

The Type 2 is designed for use with traditional TM Spec M4 series AEG receives. This is where the buffer tube slides onto a stock tail on the back of the receiver and is secured by a bolt. (Modification of the receiver and gearbox is required)

  • The UGS regulator can accept up to 900psi allowing for the use of either standard output HPA tanks as well as SLP (SLP recommended).
  • Compatible with all standard 2.000″ diameter HPA tanks and most 2.000″ tank stocks used in paintball applications.
  • Simple zip-tie lockout/tournament lock.
  • Adjustable length of pull.

products.description:
Code Name “Simple Jack”

The JACK™ was designed to answer the demand for an affordable, high performance HPA (High Pressure Air) conversion for AEG’s. The system is a drop-in cylinder replacement that is universally compatible with a wide range of gearbox versions that have center-line nozzles.

Similar to its sister products, the JACK™ replaces the original gearbox components with a programmable pneumatic system allowing for higher performance and greater reliability over a gear driven system. Although economically priced, the JACK™ still retains the same performance and quality you have come to expect from PolarStar products.

The JACK™ has only one moving part, the nozzle, which acts as its own poppet valve. Similar to the Fusion Engine™ and F2™ poppet, the nozzle is only piloted by the solenoid to open air flow through the poppet with none of the firing air coming from the solenoid itself. This design lets the JACK™ send a higher flow of air down the barrel than systems that only use a solenoid as the firing valve.

products.name: Gate X-ASR Mosfet
products.short_description: X-ASR is the world’s first 4th generation MOSFET protected against reverse polarity. It saves space, time and money because additional regular fuse is no longer needed. Acting as an electronic guard, X-ASR improves your…
products.description:
X-ASR is the world’s first 4th generation MOSFET protected against reverse polarity. It saves space, time and money because additional regular fuse is no longer needed. Acting as an electronic guard, X-ASR improves your blaster’s safety and durability through conformal coating and self-test with 2 LEDs. Although designed for up to M120 springs, in case of high torque motor and gears you can use stronger spring.

 

What makes X-ASR so special?

  • No additional fuse required in blaster installation
  • Automatic resettable protection against reverse polarity – protects motor and the MOSFET itself in the event of reverse polarity. Reverse connection will not damage the MOSFET or motor; the blaster will work again once you connect the battery in the right way.
  • Smart fuse – protects MOSFET in case of motor jam. It prevents from overheating, overloading and overcurrenting. The MOSFET is protected against short circuit of signal and motor wires. In case of too strong blaster configuration, the smart fuse will turn off the MOSFET in order to prevent overheating.
  • Built-in self-test – 2 LEDs allow for quick troubleshooting
  • Conformal coating – Military Specification MIL-V-173C provides resistance to difficult atmospheric conditions

 

What are X-ASR’s biggest assets?

  • Mosfet – targets energy from the battery directly to the motor, bypassing the mechanical trigger contacts. As a result, your rifle gains higher rate of fire as well as faster trigger response. Moreover, trigger contacts are protected against burnout.
  • Debouncing – provides full compatibility with micro-switches and ensures complete resistance to contact bounce (vibration). Your blaster gains higher ROF, faster trigger response and your MOSFET is less prone to overheating.

 

What is your blaster protected from when having X-ASR?

  • Simple motor jam consequences – after a motor jam, the MOSFET will not be damaged due to too high current or overheating
  • Damage resulting from battery reverse polarity – since R/C mini-tamiya connector has different polarity than the airsoft one, lack of experience or precaution while connecting the battery will cause no damage to it
  • Consequences of using weak NiCd/NiMH batteries – the MOSFET will not be damaged due to too low voltage
  • Damage to insulation of blaster installation and short circuit
  • Harms caused by poor weather conditions

Behind the lines 

Considering its functions, X-ASR is an improved version of NanoASR MOSFET. However, when designing X-ASR, we focused even more on its reliability.

The most important assumption was that it must be installed without any additional fuse. All the other MOSFETs we offer require supplementary fuse in blaster installation. To eliminate such necessity, we implemented the smart fuse and protection against reverse polarity in X-ASR.

 

Get ready for these amazing functions:

SMART FUSE

We have developed an electronic fuse with an accurate current sensor. A combination of current, voltage and temperature measurements makes your blaster installation highly reliable. It protects the MOSFET against overheating, overloading and short-circuiting. If your blaster becomes jammed, the function protects the motor and battery against damage.
 

MOSFET

Do you want to achieve a higher ROF and faster trigger response? Are you planning a power upgrade of your blaster? In that case, you need a MOSFET.

It targets the energy from the battery directly to the motor, bypassing the mechanical trigger contacts. As a result, you gain a higher ROF of the blaster and a faster trigger response.
 

DEBOUNCING

This provides full compatibility with the micro-switches. It ensures full resistance to contact bounce (vibration). You gain a bigger ROF, a faster trigger response and your MOSFET is less prone to overheating.
 

BUILT-IN SELF-TEST

This allows you to quickly check whether the device is working properly. It helps to locate where the problem lies when anything goes wrong.
 

COATING

Thanks to its special conformal coating, our product is resistant to atmospheric conditions (Military Specification MIL-V-173C).

The receiver and handguard design provides the MK1 with a modern and aggressive appearance. The handguard was made in M-Lok system, which allows for the customization of the positioning of rails according to User preferences. The gel blaster also features a custom, enlarged charging handle.

The heart of the Phantom MK1 consists of a eSilveredge SDU Gearbox. A unique technology has been used during the production process of this gearbox in order to assure the most accurate polish and finish of its elements.  The gel blaster is equipped with a Quick Spring Change System that allows the User to change the spring without having to open up the gearbox. The Phantom Extremis MK1 has many amazing features and simply looks stunning!

  • Suitable Hopup: DK-Gen 10 Reverse Thread Hopup 
  • Recommended Gels – Ultra Hard

** Battery, Charger & Gels not included

ESILVEREDGE GEARBOX SDU INSTRUCTIONS/SPEC

SDU2.0 is a programmable ECU chips that is being used in eSilver Edge Gear Box

Simply pressing down the button underneath the gear box, user can switch its fire selector modes (total 5 different modes). No external device or trigger control are needed, it is easy to program anytime and anywhere by the user.

First, connect your AEG with a fully charged battery (7.4V) Battery. The usual battery that you used when you play.

Second, find the switch button. The button is located underneath the gear box reachable from the magwell of the lower receiver.

How to change the mode?

Step 1) Press and hold the button. You will see a Red LED light on, hold till you see its blinking 2 times, release the button to accept the changes. Repeat Step 1 to continue your choice.

Choice of Firing Mode:

Mode 1 (Default)

Safe

Semi

Auto

Mode 2

Safe

Semi

Three Burst

Mode 3

Safe

Two Burst

Auto

Mode 4

Safe

Three Burst

Auto

Mode 5

Safe

Three Burst

Nine Burst

**Double click the button or unplug the battery anytime to reset the ECU back to its factory settings (Mode 1) **

Use of Advanced S.D.U.™ chips

The S.D.U.™ chipset that is used in the eSilver Edge Gear Box has a unique function that stops the gearbox from further damage if the electric current is too high. Simply to say, electric current / Ampere will increase if there is a malfunction inside the gearbox. For instant, bad motor, damaged gears or short circuit. When our S.D.U. detects more than 5 trigger presses in exceed Amps, the whole gearbox will shut down to prevent further damage. User has to disconnect and then reconnect the power supply to reboot the gearbox, we strongly recommended the user to check the internals immediately if mal-function happens.

Micro Switch Trigger

The eSilver Edge Gear Box standard comes with a micro switch trigger which works together with the S.D.U.™,  providing you an instant trigger response when shooting. Base on our testing, the response time of the switch is just 0.02 sec and designed for two hundred thousand presses. With the short stroke design of the trigger, it is unbelievably fast and you won’t feel any trigger delay when shooting.

products.description:
XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol – Futuristic Power & Precision

The XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper-Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol delivers a bold, futuristic design combined with a highly practical feeding system that sets it apart from traditional gel blaster pistols. Built for fast-paced backyard play and casual skirmishing, the ZP2 blends eye-catching sci-fi styling with simple, dependable operation.

At the heart of the ZP2 is its top-mounted hopper feed system, allowing multiple gel balls to be loaded at once and fed directly into the firing mechanism. This eliminates the need for standard stick magazines, reduces reload interruptions, and keeps the pistol lightweight and easy to handle. The result is a smooth, user-friendly gel blaster that’s ideal for beginners, younger players, or anyone looking for something a little different from conventional pistol designs. Note: Top mount hopper can feed a little irregularly, as gravity is the only force feeding the gels. If you get misfires, with no gel balls being fired, turn the unit upside down and shake gently to ensure that two gels aren’t caught next to each other in the loading neck.

The ZP2’s compact frame and ergonomic grip make it comfortable to use for extended sessions, while its clean Green Camo finish enhances the futuristic aesthetic. Whether you’re plinking targets in the backyard, introducing new players to gel blasting, or adding a unique sidearm to your collection, the XYL ZP2 offers a fun, accessible, and visually distinctive experience. Another super cool feature is the included tactical torch, which can be mounted into the front of the blaster. Simply remove the dome-shaped blanking cap, and push the torch in. Once in place, push the end of the torch to turn it on, then push it again to turn it off (1 x AA battery required, not included)

XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol Features:

Description

XYL ZP2 Black Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol – Futuristic Power & Precision

The XYL ZP2 Black Hopper-Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol delivers a bold, futuristic design combined with a highly practical feeding system that sets it apart from traditional gel blaster pistols. Built for fast-paced backyard play and casual skirmishing, the ZP2 blends eye-catching sci-fi styling with simple, dependable operation.

At the heart of the ZP2 is its top-mounted hopper feed system, allowing multiple gel balls to be loaded at once and fed directly into the firing mechanism. This eliminates the need for standard stick magazines, reduces reload interruptions, and keeps the pistol lightweight and easy to handle. The result is a smooth, user-friendly gel blaster that’s ideal for beginners, younger players, or anyone looking for something a little different from conventional pistol designs. Note: Top mount hopper can feed a little irregularly, as gravity is the only force feeding the gels. If you get misfires, with no gel balls being fired, turn the unit upside down and shake gently to ensure that two gels aren’t caught next to each other in the loading neck.

The ZP2’s compact frame and ergonomic grip make it comfortable to use for extended sessions, while its clean black finish enhances the futuristic aesthetic. Whether you’re plinking targets in the backyard, introducing new players to gel blasting, or adding a unique sidearm to your collection, the XYL ZP2 offers a fun, accessible, and visually distinctive experience. Another super cool feature is the included tactical torch, which can be mounted into the front of the blaster. Simply remove the dome-shaped blanking cap, and push the torch in. Once in place, push the end of the torch to turn it on, then push it again to turn it off (1 x AA battery required, not included)

products.description:
Introducing the TianGong Arp9 AEG Gel Blaster, a top-notch simulated firearm toy that falls within the submachine gun/CQB series of blasters, featuring a compact gun body for enhanced manoeuvrability and easy target acquisition.

Crafted in strong and light Nylon Polymer, this gel blaster boasts a stunning and intricate design, making it an ideal choice for collectors and skirmishers alike. Its gearing and spring setting ensures a decent firing speed, extended range, and reasonable precision, providing players with a remarkably realistic gaming experience.

The TianGong Arp9 offers the standard fire select shooting modes; safe, semi automatic and full auto, allowing players to adapt to different in-game scenarios. Enhanced anti-shake functionality ensures improved accuracy during dynamic battlefield situations.

Equipped with a detachable magazine and an adjustableÂ  plastic â€œIronâ€ sights, the gel blaster provides added convenience for players to seamlessly change and fine-tune their equipment. Users can expect an outstanding shooting experience coupled with unparalleled entertainment enjoyment. The TG ARP9 also boasts a full length top picatinny rail, with small picatinny sections on the underside and sides of the handguard. The rear plastic site, when folded flat, also can act as a picatinny riser, if you want to mount sights or optics.

When comparing theÂ XYL Arp9â€™sÂ with the TG Arp9, the key distinction lies in economy levels. Both exhibit impressive performance, but the TG Arp9 stands out as a cost-effective option, offering remarkable value for money. Despite a minimal performance gap, the significant difference in price makes the TG Arp9 a highly recommended choice among Gel Blaster enthusiasts and players alike. Elevate your gaming experience with the TianGong Arp9 AEG Gel Blaster â€“ where performance meets affordability.

  • Adjustable Buttstock
  • Fire Select: Safe, Semi Auto and Full Auto

products.name: Perun V2 Hybrid Mosfet
products.short_description: Perun V2 Hybrid Mosfet is a premium gel blaster gear listing with clearer tactical detail, fast Australia-wide dispatch and a more confident buying path. Secure current stock while availability remains live.
products.description:
Perun V2 Hybrid replaces mechanical contacts in your airsoft replica or gel blaster and provides lots of useful features. Optical and magnetic sensors allow to eliminate many moving parts that are prone to damage, thus increasing the reliability. Adaptive trigger control allows switching from a very short trigger travel to a long one even in the field, with almost any trigger, including stock ones.
Works without the need for any modification with most V2 gearboxes in Tokyo Marui standard. For details and exceptions please refer to the manual.

Perun V2 Hybrid Mosfet Features;

  • Adjustable trigger sensitivityÂ â€“ The trigger can be set to 5 sensitivity levels, ranging from very short pull needed to fire a shot, to a very long one. No modification to the trigger or the gearbox is needed and the trigger sensitivity change is possible even in the field.
  • Independently programmed firing modesÂ â€“ Program the firing modes any way you like, setting safe, semi, burst or auto on both selector positions.
  • Active brakeÂ â€“ active brake stops the motor after each shot preventing spring compression or in case of replicas with high rate of fire, over spin (double shot problem).
  • Pre-cockingÂ â€“ Fast trigger response can be a matter of victory or defeat, especially in CQB situations. With pre-cocking enabled, piston will remain in rear position after each shot with the spring already compressed, ensuring that next shot will be fired immediately after you pull the trigger. To release the spring after using pre-cocking, pull the trigger and hold it for 2 seconds, after which a second shot will be fired, this time with no pre-cocking and fully braked.
  • 2-stage triggerÂ â€“ Light trigger pull results with a single shot or burst, while a deeper pull will cause a burst or fully automatic fire. Following modes are available: semi â€“ burst, semi â€“ auto and burst â€“ auto.
  • Binary triggerÂ â€“ Allows for easy double shots in semi-automatic setting. After enabling this mode, if semi-automatic fire is set, shots will be fired not only when the trigger is pulled, but also when it is released.
  • Rate of fire reductionÂ â€“ Reduce the rate of fire in automatic or burst fire to save ammo or make the replica shoot in a more realistic fashion.
  • DMR modeÂ â€“ Introduces intervals between semiautomatic shots to comply with DMR rules on some fields.
  • Low battery voltage alarmÂ â€“ Dedicated for Li-Po and Li-Ion batteries. Should the battery voltage fall to a dangerously low level, user will be notified by short sound signals that are repeated every minute. This may also be freely switched on and off.
  • DSGÂ â€“ a sector gear detection mode specially prepared to work with dual sector gears.
  • Diagnostic systemÂ â€“ Constantly monitors the replica and the mosfet itself. In case of any problems, immediately lets you know what it might be, making troubleshooting much easier.
  • Electronic fuseÂ â€“ Will save your replica and battery in case of a major malfunction. It will automatically disconnect the battery when a short circuit or blocked motor is detected.

Programming of all the settings is done solely by using quick and easily memorable sequences of fire selector switching and trigger pulls supported by sound signals and multicolour LED diode. That allows changing the settings in any moment, in a matter of seconds, even under enemy fire. All settings are set independently for each selector position, so you can program the mosfet exactly the way you want, for example semi on semi and binary trigger on auto.
Perun V2 Hybrid works without problems with any battery from 7V do 17V. It can also be used with most extreme setups.

Externally the MP7 is packed full of features. Â It has a telescoping stock which can fully collapse to allow the gun to be used like a pistol. Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain of any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

You can store gel balls in a bucket of water with a lid for up to 3 months before they start to go super soft. We recommend if you do this to change the water every couple of weeks.

FIRE MODES:
Independent for every position on the fire selector (SAFE – SEMI – AUTO)
– SAFE: no responding on the trigger pull.
– Semi: it fires single shot per trigger pull.
– Semi/Burst X: short trigger pull fires single shot, long trigger pull fires burst.
– Binary trigger: it fires single shot when trigger is pulled and another single shot when is released.
– Burst X: shoot burst per trigger pull.
– Burst X+Burst Y: short trigger press fires burst X, long trigger press makes burs tX+burst Y fire.
– Burst X/Full: short trigger press fires burst X, long trigger press makes auto fire.
– Full: makes auto fire until releasing trigger.
– Virtual reload: pull trigger to reload virtual magazine

EXTERNAL INPUT:

–Â OFF: Every signal to Input terminal is ignored.
–Â External trigger: trigger is disabled and replaced by micro switch connected to Input (SIG and GND)
–Â Burst-3 trigger:Â micro switch connected to Input (SIG and GND) make 3 burst fire when it is pressed. Trigger is still functional.
–Â AUG trigger: selector plate detection is disabled. Trigger is set to selector on semi. Micro switch connected to Input (SIG, GND) is set to selector on auto.
–Â Empty mag (NO): Micro switch activates empty magazine detection, when is connected SIG with GND.
–Â Empty mag (NC): Micro switch activates empty magazine detection, when is disconnected SIG with GND.
–Â Virtual reload: Micro switch activates virtual magazine reload, when is connected SIG with GND.

EXTERNAL OUTPUT:
Works with Output terminal:

–Â OFF: output terminal works only if the Input terminal activates it.
–Â Motor:Â output terminal is ON with motor + with IN activation.
–Â Motor + Xs:Â output terminal is ON with motor with time delay after motor is deactivated + with IN activation.
–Â Always on: the output terminal is constantly activated.

– The braking effect is the most powerful with high torque motor. Note: Lower braking intensity spares the motor coils.

USE WITH BRUSHLESS MOTOR:

  • Active brake = Off
  • Rate of fire = 100%

PACKING:

SAFETY WARNING:
